note: Not a knob: the file bin/merge-conductor-project.sh hands a lease-held project run (BH-6890). When it exists, bin/merge-conductor.sh starts no further PR worker (the PR boundary) and skips the tier-2 and external enqueue steps. The entry touches it on TERM; mc_lease_fence_ok and the entry's renew loop touch it when the project lease is lost. A path, so NOT settable from the control plane.
